violation_type.title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children
violation_type.typical_finding: Based upon the information gathered during the investigation, evidence was available to support safety precautions for loading and unloading children to ensure all children were accounted for was not followed.  As a result, a child was left on the van unattended.

finding_variants.text: Based upon the information gathered during the investigation, evidence was available to support safety precautions for loading and unloading children to ensure all children were accounted for was not followed.  As a result, a child was left on the van unattended.
2 caregivers were observed not conducting the name to face as the children exited the vehicle.
An employee parked and the left the daycare vehicle, without ensuring that each child was accounted for.
The driver failed to account for all children while unloading the bus and again prior to parking and exiting the vehicle.
It was determined that staff failed to follow transportation procedures when they did not account for all children while unloading.

It was determined that the driver of the vehicle failed to follow operational procedures by not conducting a proper name-to-face check when unloading children, resulting in a child being left on the vehicle.
